scene: The squat vending machine dispenses a chilled glass bottle of sweet milk.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a level stone street. On the left hangs the blue noren curtain over the bathhouse entrance. At centre, the grandfather in his navy apron holds his bicycle and a cold glass milk bottle beside the brass robot vendor. On the right, steam puffs from a round brass street grate.
shown: a capped glass milk bottle held in grandfather's hand at centre
a doorway draped with blue noren curtains on the left
a brass grate venting thick warm steam on the right
